title: tailwind-merge
description: Merge Tailwind CSS classes intelligently without style conflicts.

data.text: tailwind-merge is a utility that merges Tailwind CSS class strings intelligently. When conflicting classes are detected, it keeps only the later class, preventing style conflicts in conditional logic.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install tailwind-merge
# or
yarn add tailwind-merge

data.title: Merge Classes
With clsx
data.text: Combine tailwind-merge with clsx to handle both conditional logic and class conflicts.

data.title: Combined Utility
Key Takeaways
points: It keeps the last occurrence of a conflicting utility
Pairs well with clsx for dynamic styles
data.takeaway: tailwind-merge is essential for clean, conflict-free Tailwind class management.
